description: This file implements quantized tensor addition operations, including support for different backends like QNNPACK, XNNPACK, and ACL, with functions for quantized addition, scalar addition, and fused ReLU variants. It defines dispatchers, input checks, and registration of functions for the quantized namespace.

methods.name: check_inputs
methods.description: Checks that input tensors have the same quantization scheme and data type.

methods.name: qadd
methods.description: Performs quantized addition with support for different backends and fused ReLU.

methods.name: qadd_out
methods.description: Performs quantized addition with output tensor specified.

methods.name: qadd_scalar2
methods.description: Performs scalar addition with scalar as first argument.

methods.name: qadd_scalar_out
methods.description: Performs quantized scalar addition with output tensor specified.

methods.name: int8_add_tensor_onednn
methods.description: Performs quantized addition using OneDNN backend.

methods.name: quantized_add
methods.description: Public API function for quantized addition.
